note: Re-judged 2026-11-03 by an independent auditor who authored none of 816ce1ce4c, 2cbd255ba4, 2e5c2d012a, d22b811ce4 or 1a2ccaeef8 (phase 5 of spec-filter-wire-0-umbrella, the per-peer text filter chain deleted). RFC 4271 Section 5.1.4 read: "If a BGP speaker is configured to remove the MULTI_EXIT_DISC attribute from a route, then this removal MUST be done prior to determining the degree of preference of the route and prior to performing route selection (Decision Process phases 1 and 2)." Scope moved: reactor TestMEDRemovalMechanismIsConfigurable was deleted by 2e5c2d012a with its text-directive converter (ExtractMEDRemoveOps, textDeltaToModOps, filter_delta.go), RFC-approved in that commit, and no longer carries the row. Remaining carriers re-read. filter_modify TestHandleFilterUpdateMEDRemoveIsImportOnly now parses the definitions through parseModifyDefs (del med, with and without a local-preference set) and drives the live evaluateModify over a FilterRoute; wantSets is exact and ordered: import answers modify with exactly "med remove null" (and "local-preference set 200" before it), export answers accept with no set for DROP-MED and only the local-preference set for DROP-AND-LP, so a removal answered on export, or dropped on import, goes red. That is stronger than the old delta-string unit, which bypassed the config parser. test/plugin/med-removal-before-decision.ci (only change since the last stamp: an explicit export final accept, 3cb09bb0a9, which leaves the import chain modify:DROP-MED and every expect line untouched) now runs on the library chain because the text chain is gone: it requires the Adj-RIB-In stored route to carry no attribute 4 and the exact ORIGIN, AS_PATH and COMMUNITIES survivors, which is the before-phase-1 store. med-removal-configured.ci (rs-client receiver, so the automatic strip cannot satisfy it) and med-removal-export-refused.ci (export directive preserves the MED frame) are unchanged. Producers now: filter_modify.go medRemoveFor, policychain sets.go the AttrModSuppress on code 4, the import step payload replacing the WireUpdate before cache and dispatch (reactor_notify.go). Ran ./le test bgp plugin on all three .ci at HEAD: PASS (scratch audit-p5-med-removal-*.log); unit PASS. Nit, not a verdict change: the before-decision.ci header still names TestMEDRemovalMechanismIsConfigurable (reactor/forward_med_test.go), which no longer exists, as the proof of the unfiltered half; the confining negative it carries is the surviving attributes, which the body checks. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
